name: change-intake
category: Workflow · Change proposal → routing decision → RFC/Task Pool issues or local plan
description: Routes a proposed change into the right tracking structure. Probes whether the repo is on GitHub and whether gh is authenticated with issue write permission; on GitHub a feature becomes an RFC main issue with child issues and a fix becomes a Task Pool main issue with fix records, all cross-referenced by a local changes/ record. Without GitHub, gh auth or issue permission it delegates to plan-flow and plans into the repository's plans/ directory. Gates and timestamps are enforced by a standard-library Python script.

runtime: Python 3.9+ standard library only, no pip packages
GitHub CLI (gh), authenticated with issue write permission, for the github mode
